title: Lifting a computation
statement: Let $\Gamma$ have decidable equality, let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding. For any Boolean input word $x$, any configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, and any $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the lifted machine from the lifted configuration for $t$ steps gives the lift of the configuration reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
